reason: I'd ask our Epicor partner before anything else, and I'm not sending open PO and job data to a startup I've never heard of, even sanitized, without IT and my boss signing off. Our BOM and job data is messy, so I don't trust a result built on it either.
objection: If our BOM and job data is messy, any analysis will be wrong, and an outside company would be working from exports I can't check against Epicor myself.
would_change_my_mind: Our Epicor partner vouching for them and IT approving a read-only export process that they run on our data before any commitment.
